CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 12

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 36

3. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27

4. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

5. Solve for x: x + 3 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 8
   C. 3
   D. 6

6. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 38
   C. 22
   D. 88

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 144

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 1
   D. 7

10. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 57
   C. 56
   D. 1

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 46
   C. 23
   D. 120

12. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 16
   C. 5
   D. 8

13. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 3
   C. 41
   D. 13

14. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

15. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

16. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

17. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

18. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

19. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

20. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

21. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

22. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 17

23. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 121

24. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 29
   D. 23.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
